newsitem.title: USA: DIGEX Inc offers 3.75 mln shr IPO at $9-$11/shr.
newsitem.headline: DIGEX Inc offers 3.75 mln shr IPO at $9-$11/shr.

text.p: Washington, D.C.-based Internet carrier DIGEX Inc said Tuesday it has filed an amended registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of 3,750,000 shares of common stock at $9 to $11 per share.
All shares offered are to be issued and sold by DIGEX, the company said.
The company first announced an initial public offering in June but nullified the offering a week later, said company spokesman John Riggin.
